maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from producing concerts, selling tickets and sponsorship, which are new events and purchases, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Fans buy tickets and brands pay sponsorships; revenue is consumer and corporate, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly from concerts, ticketing and sponsorship scale; acquisitions of promoters and venues are occasional, not the main driver.

mission_critical.reason: Concert promotion and sponsorship are competitive; fans can attend other events, though Ticketmaster contracts with venues are sticky.

notes: Ticketing has sticky venue contracts, so mission_critical is borderline; concerts are the larger part of revenue.
